sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: Pros first: zest and segments are both useful. It can work as a snack, flavour boost, or cooking ingredient. Brings a clean fruit identity. It still contributes something valuable even when it is not elite. Ingredient simplicity is hard to argue with. Whole-fruit clarity is part of the category appeal.

sections.title: Cons
sections.narration: Downsides next: easy to eat quickly when it is very sweet. That can blur the line between light and sugar-heavy portions. Satiety is not especially strong. Fruit often needs help from the rest of the meal. Peeling can limit convenience. It is portable, but still less instant than a wash-and-eat fruit.
